title: London Eats: 8 date-night restaurants for autumn
content:
Our pick of places for a special evening:
- Verdant (Fitzrovia): seasonal vegetarian tasting menu, candlelit. https://verdant.example
- Osteria Lupa (Islington): neighbourhood Italian, handmade pasta, lots for vegetarians. https://osterialupa.example
- The Greenhouse Kitchen (Camden): relaxed plant-based small plates. https://greenhousekitchen.example
- Smokehouse 54 (Shoreditch): Texas-style BBQ for serious meat lovers. https://smokehouse54.example
- Dishoom (King's Cross): Bombay cafe classics, always buzzing. https://dishoom-kx.example
- Padella (Borough): famous fresh pasta, expect a queue. https://padella-borough.example
- Little Owl Bistro (Islington): cosy French bistro. https://littleowlbistro.example
- Blue Note Cellar (Soho): live jazz and cocktails. https://bluenotecellar.example

title: Verdant - vegetarian tasting menu, Fitzrovia
content:
Verdant serves a seven-course seasonal vegetarian tasting menu (vegan on request). £75 per person.
Opening hours: Wednesday to Sunday, 18:00-22:30 (last seating 21:00). Closed Monday and Tuesday.
Reservations: email bookings@verdant.example with the date, time and number of guests. We reply within 24 hours.

title: Osteria Lupa - Italian, Islington
content:
Handmade pasta and wood-fired dishes, with plenty of vegetarian options on every menu. Mains £16-24.
Opening hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 17:30-22:30. Closed Sunday and Monday.
Bookings: email table@osterialupa.example with your date, time and party size.

title: The Greenhouse Kitchen - plant-based small plates, Camden
content:
Relaxed all-vegetarian small plates and natural wine.
Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 12:00-22:00.
Bookings: bookings@greenhousekitchen.example

title: Smokehouse 54 - Texas BBQ, Shoreditch
content:
Brisket, ribs and burnt ends smoked for 14 hours. Very limited vegetarian options (one side salad).
Opening hours: every day, 17:00-23:00.
Bookings: hello@smokehouse54.example

title: Dishoom King's Cross
content:
Bombay cafe classics in a former railway goods yard. Good vegetarian choice.
Opening hours: every day, 08:00-23:00. Bookings for groups of 6 or more only; smaller groups walk in.

title: Padella - fresh pasta, Borough Market
content:
Hand-rolled pasta made fresh every morning. Vegetarian dishes available.
Opening hours: every day, 12:00-22:00. We don't take bookings: walk-ins only.

title: Little Owl Bistro - permanently closed
content: After twelve wonderful years, Little Owl Bistro has closed its doors for good. Thank you for everything.

title: Blue Note Cellar - live jazz, Soho
content:
Live jazz every Thursday, Friday and Saturday from 20:00. Cocktails and bar snacks only, no dinner menu.
Tickets £25: email boxoffice@bluenotecellar.example with the date and number of tickets.

title: London weather this week
content: Mild and dry most of the week, with rain likely on Sunday evening.
